title: live servers, proximity text chat with players and NPCs, a live leaderboard and where everyone is (the claude.ai artifact room)
lensAText: a sceptical multiplayer game UX lead and trust-and-safety reviewer. Read /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/wf/brief-live.md and the room contract it names. Look at every frame the builder cites with the Read tool, then build dist/artifact.html yourself and run ONE short Playwright script with the builder's mock room (several pages in one context) at 390x844 (phone viewport copy, isMobile, hasTouch, DPR 3) and 1280x720: two or three players on the I-5 and in Lot 57 and the sports bar. Judge: do other players' cars and characters appear, move smoothly and carry name tags; does proximity chat reach only people in range (on foot 5 m, road 60 m); is typing blocked while driving except stopped/Auto-drive/paused with the quick chips instead; are bubbles and the log readable on the phone and uncluttered; does the Servers list show real counts and the 100 cap; does the leaderboard show nick, server, place and score with 'self-reported'; does the filter do exactly the owner's examples (level 6: 'ass' -> 'a**', 'butt' and 'buttocks' allowed), catch evasions without false positives (class, bass, assistant, passenger), and block slurs at every level; do NPCs answer in character, positive, with a vetted fact; do Mute/Block work; does the game show NO live UI and no errors with no window.claude (the standalone file); are the honesty lines right (no fake players or counts; 'Live with people who have access to this game on claude.ai'). Reject on: any fake live data, real claude.ai names shown without need, chat reaching out-of-range players' screens, the filter missing the owner's examples, or a regression in boot/phone/venues.
brief: Read /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/wf/brief-live.md in full FIRST and follow it; it is the brief (the owner's words, the artifact room transport and its contract, servers, presence, remote players, places, proximity chat, scripted NPCs with facts, the 1-10 filter, the leaderboard, safety, honesty, what not to edit, and the proof).
